opinions.text: Motion of New Yorkers for Constitutional Freedoms, et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Motion of Marriage Law Foundation for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Motion of Adam J. MacLeod for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Motion of Them Before Us for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the Appellate Division, Supreme Court of New York, Second Judicial Department denied.
